axis_notes.hook: A real page arrival begins immediately and the identity glyph has separated by 1.35s. The amber corner and mint identity create an intelligible visual question. The initial desk-and-folder arrangement is quiet and its scroll-stopping force is modest.
axis_notes.story: A dated institutional report leads to a specific administrative application, the old manual action, extraction/linking and sorting, the attributed time benefit, and a clear limit on patient outcomes. The opening chart question is answered and the earlier-care question remains appropriately open. The final question is repeated more than it develops.
axis_notes.picture: Actual subjects change in all 20 directed intervals. The fax-to-chart transfer at 17.8s and retained amber corner make the mechanism comprehensible with captions covered. Sorting and the separate patient clock add meaning. The tiny work-clearing action, crowded extraction overlay and repeated patient reveal prevent a stronger score.
axis_notes.place: A plausible illustrated clinic interior, appropriate ordinary work equipment, a bare hand and a seated patient produce no Harris County contradiction or costume error. The room is otherwise generic. Houston is established mainly by labels and source attribution rather than observed architecture, vegetation or local kit.
axis_notes.craft: At 390px the main captions are clear and the key fax, chart, hand and patient are readable. Consistent amber/mint coding supports cuts and left-to-right handoffs. The small report date, partly occluded Patient wait label, overlapping extracted lines and large empty floor area weaken hierarchy. Source leaf and patient reveals have clear purpose, but spatial resets and repeated reveals feel diagrammatic.
axis_notes.voice: No direct listening was available. The score is limited to the supplied transcript, timing and acoustic evidence:97 matched spoken tokens, measured caption cue boundaries, unstretched audio,39.12s take duration and master at -17.66LUFS with the bed19dB below voice. These support technical competence and intelligibility planning but cannot certify natural performance, pronunciation quality or a compelling listen.

axis_reasons.hook: The first frame has a desk and chart rather than a title card, and the large fax arrival plus detached identity token pay off within the opening window; the image is clear but its administrative stakes are quieter than an arresting human action.
axis_reasons.story: A dated UTHealth Houston account, concrete manual-to-software mechanism, attributed staff benefit, explicit absence of appointment-wait evidence, and a useful next question form a coherent miniature documentary. The final patient comparison earns the limit instead of merely appending a disclaimer.
axis_reasons.picture: The film uses actual page arrival, extraction, chart docking, splitting, sorting and a patient reveal. It is not a held-slide sequence. The extraction strip overlaps the chart from roughly 14.9 to 17.7 seconds, the matching backplates move only subtly, and the staff-time page at 23.5 seconds is small, reducing clarity and visual force.
axis_reasons.place: The bright clinic interior, work surface, keyboard, chair and cast contain no visible contradiction of Harris County. The window and room remain generic, so the Houston specificity rests mainly on institutional attribution and labels rather than distinctive observed local detail.
axis_reasons.craft: The amber corner and mint record retain identity across the joins, the captions are legible at phone scale, and source/credit text stays within the visible frame. Large empty lower areas and overlapping mechanism lines leave room for stronger composition. Sound-event intent is documented but its audible effectiveness was not assessed.
axis_reasons.voice: The available evidence supports accurate text reconciliation, sentence-level measured caption edges, preserved audio speed and a technically controlled mix. No direct listening was available, so this score is provisional on performance and gives no credit for unverified warmth, acting, pronunciation quality or sonic storytelling.

axis_notes.hook: The incoming sheet and detached patient glyph create an understandable sound-off puzzle by about 1.35 seconds; the actual first frame is a quiet desk, and the paper icon is clear rather than startling.
axis_notes.story: The dated university report, former manual task, literal automation mechanism, administrative consequence, source attribution and bounded care question form a coherent miniature story. The final patient/chart contrast earns the take without asserting a clinical benefit.
axis_notes.picture: The document moves, fields transfer, pages separate and settle, and a patient enters the story. These are visible subjects rather than changing headlines. The tiny staff-clock papers and almost identical record spines are weak intervals, and the same room geometry limits visual variety.
axis_notes.place: Harris County is consistent with Houston; pale humid glare, flat distant building masses, ordinary clinic kit and an uncostumed patient do not contradict the place. A generic window, an isolated arm and a simple figure do little to establish a clinic that a Houston viewer would recognize. The label carries most of the local identity.
axis_notes.craft: The amber corner and mint identity maintain continuity through close/wide changes. Main captions remain legible with clear contrast. Large empty lower areas coexist with tiny labels and source graphics; the partly covered patient-wait label near 28 to 30 seconds, translucent extraction overlap, and spare wear detail reduce finish.
axis_notes.voice: Technical evidence supports complete narration, measured cue boundaries on the final mix timeline, no stretching, and music below the voice. The verified phrase edges and 97 ASR matches do not establish natural acting. No direct listening was available, so this score does not certify an expressive or compelling performance.
